name: jolpica_f1-mcp
description: Jolpica F1 (Ergast-compatible Formula 1 data) (competitions): discover, get_competition, standings.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: The current season's Grands Prix in calendar order (id 'season/round', e.g. 2026/5). No search: query, kind and status are not applied.

tools.name: get_competition
tools.description: competition_id is 'season/round' (2026/5), as discover returns it.

tools.name: standings
tools.description: Race classification of one Grand Prix ('season/round'): finishing position, driver (constructor), points; status and laps in raw. Empty before the race is run.
